name: game-forge
description: A web platform that generates browser-playable games from natural language prompts. Describe a game, refine the design through an AI chat, and get back a real Godot 4 HTML5 export you can play in the browser or download.

scripts.test: python -m py_compile scripts/TestAudio.py scripts/TestCode.py scripts/TestPlanner.py scripts/TestTheme.py
